description.value: New York Fries is a Canadian fast-food chain specializing in hand-cut, skin-on fries cooked to order in non-hydrogenated sunflower oil, served alongside poutines, premium hot dogs, and a range of dips. This Kelowna location sits on Harvey Avenue at what appears to be the Orchard Park Shopping Centre, a major commercial hub on the city's main arterial corridor. Touring cyclists will find a quick, filling carb stop with vegetarian and vegan-friendly options on the menu.

enrichment_extras.reasoning: The website confirms this location as 'Orchard Park Open' at 2271 Harvey Avenue, matching OSM. The fries page explicitly labels items as 'Vegetarian Vegan-Friendly Gluten-Friendly' and dips page notes 'All dips are vegetarian,' confirming dietary options. OSM takeaway=yes is corroborated by the website noting delivery apps are available; no evidence exists for bike parking, washrooms, Wi-Fi, or water refill, and the mall context (Orchard Park Shopping Centre) is inferred from the location slug but not explicitly stated on the page.
concerns: Location appears to be inside or attached to Orchard Park Shopping Centre (a mall), which may limit direct bicycle access and parking at the unit itself — cyclists may need to navigate mall parking areas.
OSM phone number could not be verified against the website; the website only lists a corporate head-office number (905-760-2244) with no location-specific phone.
enrichment_extras.recommended_status_reason: Real, confirmed-open fast-food location on a major Kelowna cycling corridor; useful to touring cyclists as a quick carb stop with vegetarian and vegan options.
